designation: retrospective exploratory design after reviewing completed primary failures and secondary summaries

formulas.ranks: Ascending 1-based ranks; exact ties receive mean occupied rank.
formulas.seed_mean: Arithmetic mean of both assessment correlations; undefined if either is constant.
formulas.model_mean: Arithmetic mean of all12 seed means; undefined if any seed is undefined.

limitations: Retrospective, descriptive rank transport; no causal age attribution or policy validation.
